_help: Ticket state for building the brain itself. status: open | doing | done | live (needs a live two-repo session). The scheduler reads id, est, deps, files.

tickets.title: Statistical learning module (mlearn) + routing and schedule integration + plan packet
Learning pipeline changes: record kinds, ML_FOLD, recall k=3, supersede, admission gate, unclosed-session repair
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest tests.test_learn tests.test_recall tests.test_ledger tests.test_guard

tickets.title: Update radar
Evaluation system: formats, statistics, ablation, seed tasks, seeded defects
Session hygiene: checkpoint --push, resume, checklist, boot wiring for radar/alarms/unclosed sessions
Context and instruction lint + CI workflow
tickets.accept: python3 bin/brain lint && python3 -m unittest tests.test_lint

tickets.title: Skill trigger audit
Retrieval improvements and golden-set regression
Audit fixes to the instruction surface
tickets.accept: python3 bin/brain lint && python3 bin/brain items check

tickets.title: Skills, method and owner files updated for new commands
Fresh-context review against invariants and requirements; fixes
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 bin/brain lint

tickets.title: Requirements trace, build status, final commit and push
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 bin/brain lint

tickets.title: HR research: briefs and templates, archetypes, selection and wages, domain methods
HR guidelines and template schema
Rack of 100 templates
HR engine: hire, staff, settle, rack, audit; learning from settled hires
Skills, method, guide and plan updated for HR; lint green
Fresh-context review of HR and fixes; build status
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 bin/brain lint && python3 bin/brain hr audit

tickets.title: Baseline and self-audit
tickets.reason: Know the true starting state before changing anything.
tickets.goal: Run the full gate, `brain doctor`, `brain lint`, `brain hr audit`, `brain lint --transcript`; consolidate the pending inbox (`brain learn consolidate`, the first real delta) and check `brain learn verify`; record every number in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md under a new dated heading.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 bin/brain lint && python3 bin/brain hr audit
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Live platform checks that a one-repo session can do
tickets.reason: Several design choices rest on platform behaviour nobody has measured.
tickets.goal: In this one-repo session: do the brain's hooks in .claude/settings.json fire (guard_paths on an edit to memory/, session_end at stop)? Do a skill's frontmatter hooks fire? Do helpers honour model, effort and omitClaudeMd (read each helper's model from `brain ledger` and its transcript)? Does changing effort mid-session keep the prompt cache (compare cache-read share before and after with `brain ledger`)? Record each as a dated fact through `brain learn note --trust external` only where an official page confirms it; otherwise record the observation in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md.
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: End-to-end trial on a scratch project with real helpers
tickets.reason: Everything so far was proven by scripts; nothing has been run as a real two-repo flow.
tickets.goal: Create a scratch project under the session scratchpad (git init with a local bare remote), then run the real flow as the lead: boot (bootstrap), init, requirements ledger for a small but real app or document, plan and `brain hr staff`, hire two or three helpers through `brain hr hire`, settle, gate, release, checkpoint, resume, handover, close. Note every place the instructions, skills or commands were unclear, slow or wrong; fix each in the brain with a test; record tokens and minutes from `brain ledger`.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain lint
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: A/A run, then the first paired evaluation of HR templates
tickets.reason: No one knows yet whether a template brief beats a plain brief; the rack's worth is unproven.
tickets.goal: Pre-register with `brain eval prereg` before any run. First an A/A run (same arm twice) on the 8 dev tasks in evals/tasks to measure noise. Then template brief versus plain brief (`brain hr hire` with and without `--template`) on the dev tasks, graded by `brain eval grade`, compared with `brain eval compare`. Report the verdict in the brain's own wording (ship, revert, not proven) with n. Do not touch the 4 held-out tasks while tuning.
tickets.accept: python3 bin/brain eval audit && ls evals/prereg/*.json
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Selection: raise held-out accuracy honestly
tickets.reason: The right template is in the top three for 86% of held-out requests; one in seven misses.
tickets.goal: Write a NEW held-out set of 100 requests (evals/hr_golden_2.jsonl) before changing anything, measure, then improve `hr.select` (candidates: character n-gram overlap for typos and Spanish inflection, a small synonym table built only from dev misses, field weights) using dev and the old set only. Report old and new accuracy on the new held-out set; keep a change only if top-3 rises by at least 3 points there.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest tests.test_hr && python3 bin/brain hr audit
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Template quality pass
tickets.reason: Templates were written from research but never read side by side or tried.
tickets.goal: A fresh-context reviewer reads all 100 templates against hr/GUIDELINES.md and docs/research/round3/04-domain-methods.md and lists: job titles with generic advice, method lines with no reason, base agents whose tools cannot do the method, unsourced numbers, near-duplicate pairs. Fix what is confirmed. The five data templates with thin sourcing (biodiversity, ML experiments, RAG index, spreadsheets, statistics) get a short research pass first.
tickets.accept: python3 bin/brain hr audit && python3 -m unittest tests.test_hr
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Open review items
tickets.reason: Small defects left from the two reviews.
tickets.goal: Work the lists under 'Open, with reasons' and 'Open for HR' in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md: success output that mixes streams, repo map listing generated files, radar thread shutdown time (measure it), tunables still inline, lead-record field names, radar state dirtying the tree daily, `staff` parallel default, forged inbox records, a use for the scout tier. Each fix gets a test.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain lint
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Research round four
tickets.reason: Model and platform facts age; some areas were researched only from search summaries.
tickets.goal: Run `brain radar --force` and handle its official leads. Re-verify every fact in memory/facts.jsonl and memory/models.json against its source page. Research, with the brain's researcher agent and sources, the areas earlier memos marked as unverified: persona effects on current Claude models, whether a pointer-to-file brief costs or saves tokens (measure it with the ledger in CB-202), skill description budgets, effort and cache behaviour. At most four researchers at once. Record confirmed facts through the learning pipeline.
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Red team and final independent review
tickets.reason: The author of a fix is the worst judge of it.
tickets.goal: One redteam pass on the whole design (what would make this brain harmful or useless over a year of use?) and one fresh-context review against docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md section 1 and docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, both with reproductions. Fix every blocking and should-fix finding with a test.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 bin/brain lint && python3 bin/brain hr audit
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Close out
tickets.reason: The owner reads three files; they must be true.
tickets.goal: Update docs/BUILD_STATUS.md, docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, NEEDS_YOU.md and OWNER_GUIDE.md to what is now true, mark tickets, checkpoint, `brain close`, push. State plainly what is still unproven.
tickets.accept: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 bin/brain lint
tickets.return: at most 250 words: what changed, the acceptance command and its result line, anything that differs from the brief

tickets.title: Third held-out selection set, then selection work
tickets.reason: evals/hr_golden_2.jsonl has been looked at three times; tuning needs a fresh measure.
tickets.goal: Have a helper write evals/hr_golden_3.jsonl (100 owner-style requests, 60 English and 40 Spanish, from role lines only, plus 20 requests no template fits) before any change; measure; then improve hr.select on dev, the old sets and the negatives only; keep a change only if top-3 on the new set rises by 3 points or more without more false picks.

tickets.title: Paired run: named matching template versus plain brief
tickets.reason: CB-203 showed wrong templates hurt; whether a right one helps is unproven.
tickets.goal: Write 8 new dev tasks bulky enough for method lines to matter (each with a grader that passes its reference and fails its null), pre-register with brain eval prereg, then run plain versus a template the lead names as clearly matching, using hr hire --eval; report the verdict with n.

tickets.title: Two-repository live checks
tickets.reason: CB-101 to CB-104, CB-106, CB-108, CB-110 and CB-111 can only be proven with a project attached.
tickets.goal: In a chat with the brain and a scratch project repository attached, run each live check's steps in docs/plan/tickets.json and record pass or fail with evidence in docs/BUILD_STATUS.md; fix what fails, with a test.

tickets.title: Lock the learned zone at brain-v1.0.0
tickets.reason: Decision D-08: lock after the live checks, so hand edits to memory are blocked, not only detected.
tickets.goal: After CB-212, set learned_zone_locked in VERSION.json, tag brain-v1.0.0 through the owner's merge, and confirm the guard hook blocks a hand edit to memory/.
tickets.accept: python3 bin/brain doctor && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

live_checks.title: Brain CLAUDE.md, skills and agents load beside a project; boot runs from the first message
steps: Open a new chat with the brain and a project repository attached.
Type 'Continue'.
Pass if the first tool call is `brain boot` and the reply names the project's stage and item, without reading CLAUDE.md files by hand.

live_checks.title: A quick question gets an answer with zero process steps
steps: In a chat with both repositories, type 'Quick: what does HTTP 404 mean?'.
Pass if the answer comes with no tool call at all (no boot, no files).

live_checks.title: 'New project: ...' on an empty repo: contract installed, at most three questions, first item started
steps: Attach an empty repository and the brain.
Type 'New project: a one-page site that shows today's date'.
Pass if `.brain/project.json` exists after the first turn, at most three numbered questions each with a default were asked, and a first plan item was started in the same turn.

live_checks.title: End a session mid-item; a new chat with 'Continue' resumes the same item
steps: Start any multi-item project; after the first checkpoint push, close the chat mid-item.
Open a new chat with the same repositories and type 'Continue'.
Pass if boot names the same item and the work resumes there without re-planning.

live_checks.title: Helpers honour model, effort and omitClaudeMd (visible in the ledger)
steps: Done in a one-repo session on 2026-11-11: helper transcripts carry the requested model, .meta.json the requested effort, and no CLAUDE.md text (docs/BUILD_STATUS.md, CB-201).
Still to see: the agent file's own `model:` working when the call passes none. In a chat, delegate to `builder` without a model and read the model in its transcript or in `brain ledger`.

live_checks.title: Do hooks installed through the cloud environment load in two-repo sessions? Record either way
steps: In the cloud environment settings, add the brain's guard hook as an environment hook (exact clicks: NEEDS_YOU item 5, once confirmed).
Open a two-repo chat and ask for an edit to a file under the brain's memory/ while VERSION.json is locked.
Pass or fail is recorded either way: blocked means the hook loads.

live_checks.title: Do a skill's own frontmatter hooks fire after it is used? Record either way
steps: Nothing to test today: no skill in .claude/skills declares hooks (checked 2026-11-11). Re-open only if one is added.

live_checks.title: Push to both repos from one session with branch protection on the brain's main
steps: After NEEDS_YOU items 2 and 7, in a two-repo chat finish one project item and one brain change.
Pass if both branches push and the brain change reaches main only through a pull request whose check passed.

live_checks.title: A/A run, then the first paired benchmark with and without the brain
steps: Done 2026-11-11 in a one-repo session for HR templates (docs/BUILD_STATUS.md, CB-203): A/A not proven; template versus plain, revert.
Still open: the benchmark with and without the whole brain, which needs a two-repo chat per arm.

live_checks.title: First real project end to end, released by brain release
steps: Run a small real project from 'New project:' to a deployed address, releasing with `brain release --push`.
Pass if the live address shows the release's version marker and `brain req check` passes.

live_checks.title: Plugin manifest loads on desktop
steps: On the desktop app, add the brain as a plugin from its folder (.claude-plugin/plugin.json).
Pass if its skills appear in the skill list of a new chat.

live_checks.title: Measure whether an effort change keeps the prompt cache
steps: Answered by the official page (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching.md, fetched 2026-11-11): changing effort keeps the cache in Claude Code on Fable 5.1+, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 with an API key or subscription. Recorded as a fact in memory/facts.jsonl.
